notes.notes: [p]We’ve been hard at work polishing gameplay, fixing bugs, and adding a few surprises. [/p][p]See you in the game![/p][p]— The Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features Skill Camera[/b] (PR #384) - Introduced dynamic skill camera views to enhance combat visuals and immersion. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Mac Build Support ([/b]PR #392)- Added support for macOS builds, expanding platform availability. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Rogue Skills[/b] (PR #381) -  Changed Aura of Agility from granting Dexterity to granting +1 Action Point for the Rogue class, improving class-specific gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Kaelen Aspen Voiceovers-[/b] Added new voiceover lines for Kaelen Aspen in the Respite Room (thanks @sir_spicyy (2s_Company)), enriching the narrative atmosphere. notes.title: Dolven is Releasing at Steam Next Fest – October 13th, 2025!
notes.notes:
Calling all Adventurers, strategists, and DND enthusiasts! 

For the past three years, I’ve been hammering away at the keyboard, pouring heart and soul into bringing this card game to life. And today, me and my small team get to say the words we’ve been dreaming of: Dolven finally has a release date!

📅 October 13th, 2025 — Steam Next Fest is when Dolven steps out into the world for the first time.

It’s an exciting moment, but also a little bittersweet. This project has been a labor of love—a constant companion through late nights, design overhauls, and bursts of creative joy. Now, it feels like I’m sending my child off into the world, hoping they find their place, unsure how they’ll be received… but proud nonetheless.

🪓 So who is this little tucker?
Dolven is a tactical RPG with deckbuilding and poker-inspired mechanics. Players can form powerful card hands during combat to unleash explosive combos. This little tucker has deadly puzzle dungeons to explore where you will battle monstrous foes, and lead a band of mercenaries on a dark quest to find a lost child, and save a kingdom.

This October, We invite you to experience what we’ve been building. Thank you for joining us on this journey. We can't wait to see what you make of Dolven.

— Andrew & Mike 
2 solo devs on a mission to rid the world of darkness. 

— The Dolven Team

notes.title: Enhancing Dolvens Strategy
notes.notes:
As we continue refining the strategic depth of Dolven, one of our core objectives is to keep players engaged and challenged by ensuring there’s no single “best” way to approach the game. We’ve heard your feedback about finding optimal strategies early on and sticking to them, and we’re actively working to diversify the strategic landscape so that players are constantly thinking on their feet.

To achieve this, we’re introducing six unique biomes into the game, each filled with its own enemies and environmental challenges. These biomes will demand different approaches to deck-building and character selection. For example, in a biome crawling with powerful mages, you’ll need to employ a different tactic—such as bringing in your rogue or archer class, paired with a deck stacked with Dexterity cards. It’s about matching your tools to the environment, ensuring that no one deck or strategy will dominate across the board.

Beyond the biomes, boss battles are getting a dynamic twist. We’re experimenting with mechanics where bosses can randomly interfere with your strategies. These unpredictable boss actions will force you to adapt on the fly, shaking up any rigid strategies and adding layers of depth to each encounter. The goal is to create an environment where strategic flexibility is rewarded, and players can “cheese” their way to victory in multiple ways—but only if they plan carefully and react to the ever-changing battlefield.

Our aim is to make Dolven a game where strategy feels fresh in every biome and each battle presents a new challenge to conquer. Stay tuned for more updates, and we look forward to seeing how you approach the shifting challenges ahead!

notes.title: Spell Cards VS Mercenary Cards; What's the Difference??
notes.notes:
There are only 2 card types in Dolven.  Mercenary Cards and Spell Cards.   The spell cards are gold with the claws in the top right corner and the Mercenary cards are blue. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/f8fbdcdd6d926383c9f47a2e5d4321ee4f74b70b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/314f4a59a132c74dc72e0be169395e7eef7acdda.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/2ab07411fa69088b5fcb12041cbaf9ac53a3e6ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/fd54e053207ec6239f2607a55ba06a04af685413.png[/img][/url]



  The two types of cards are played differently in the game.   Mercenary cards are played only on the dungeon Pillars.  When played on the pillars,  the entire column where the players are standing will be affected.    The spell cards are played directly onto and individual character and provide that character with instant effects used in combat.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/55bb51d9e01e0b7d0ef00a17c7d7f3242dd3cdab.png[/img]


The mouse is the contoller,  drag and drop a spell card onto a character 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/a6de6935f73a95955d6a18fa1a3fed85ba4e6f17.png[/img]


When dropping a Mercenary card onto a pillar, all enemy characters standing in the column of the pillar will be fired up as shown here.    The card Pyros fires up all characters in the same column. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/be66d3b65020a16293f27d1921b6e1cd58b1bb50.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/29879142dd5f8d63446a26bec522a147a1e6c883.png[/img]
